svg.title: How does what you say become permanent knowledge?
svg.desc: You talk to an AI agent session. AGENTS.md, the rule file, loads at the start of every session and tells the agent to consult the router in kb/principles. The agent proposes [?] items into schedule.md and inbox.md, appends one block to sesslog.md, and works in your project folders, which are named by where: lines. After each handback the consolidation helper reads the log and relays what waits for you. When you say pending and answer y or n, approved items become notes in kb/notes and INDEX, candidate rules, or labelled rules in kb/rules.md; repeated integrations become skill drafts in kb/skills. Your approval of a shown commit ratifies this folder, whoever runs it.
